overview: The Medford Traffic Commission addressed neighborhood traffic issues, reviewed several resident parking variance requests, and discussed parking enforcement and signage for deliveries and home health aides.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the April 2023 meeting.

items.title: Tufts University Bus Route Signage
items.summary: Referred a resident request regarding tour bus traffic on Gourley Road to Traffic Engineering, DPW, and the Police Department to pursue directional guide signage to Tufts University.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 348 High Street
items.summary: Denied a request for a parking variance on Mystic Street for vacation storage exceeding 48 hours, with police offering to help coordinate between the resident and landlord.

items.title: Delivery Truck Parking and Signage at Harvard and Main Street
items.summary: Approved additional no-parking signage along Harvard Street subject to administrative site review, referred long-term street configuration to the Engineering Department, and directed police to conduct outreach with local business owners regarding deliveries.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 1420 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Approved a parking variance granting seasonal resident permit parking and two visitor passes on Ravine Road.

items.title: Home Health Aide Parking at 99 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Voted that concerns regarding parking citations issued to home health aides were addressed after staff discussed permitting procedures, facility-provided spaces, and potential overflow parking options.

items.title: Item 2023-26
items.summary: Noted as withdrawn after the petitioner resolved the issue through existing business permit parking rules.
